observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down complex, fast choreography step-by-step with counts and verbal cues. He offers alternative easier and harder versions of difficult steps.

lesson_structure.note: welcomes viewers and introduces the challenge
breaks down the kick ball change footwork
breaks down the baseball bat arm and hip movement
breaks down shoulder and plié footwork
breaks down the advanced kick out kick down move with easier variation
breaks down the hammer motion with right heel
slow practice review with counts from the top

metaphors: like we have a baseball bat
common_mistakes: body being too stiff and upright instead of leaning
forgetting to bend knees open close

steps_taught.name: intro stomp and dip
steps_taught.description: stomp both feet and dip with arm fold

steps_taught.name: kick ball change
steps_taught.description: kick right foot out, place down, step left back change

steps_taught.name: baseball bat
steps_taught.description: prep bat and look left, bring around with right arm to forehead and right hip sit

what_works: breaking down fast movements into counts
offering easier and advanced options for hard moves
what_hinders: the choreography is very fast and intricate

quotes.text: It's a very difficult dance just because it's really fast.
The arms for the kick ball change are a bit like a freestyle.
The next part is probably the most difficult one.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates the stomp and dip movement with arms folding and unfolding facing the front.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on the feet

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaches the advanced version of a hard sequence first before offering an easier variation.
